name: Certification of Security Professional in Management - Technical
name_ja: SEA/J 応用コース・テクニカル編 (CSPM of Technical)

logistics.format: Pearson VUE proctored exam covering network security build / operate

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded Japanese MSSP relevance and two-year build/operate scope support associate network-security practice; local recognition and a short proctored exam do not establish professional architecture depth.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Network-security build and operation coverage with two years of experience supports associate technical knowledge. Recorded Japanese MSSP recognition is useful context, while no practical assessment establishes portable professional delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded network-security build and operations scope fits a two-year technical practitioner. Japanese MSSP recognition supports that associate signal, while no hands-on delivery assessment is documented.
